name: Solvana AI
description: One Interface. Any Chain. AI intent engine automating smart routing for spot, perps, and advanced limit order
longDescription: Solvana AI brings intelligent perpetual trading on Lighter through a unified execution layer. Users can trade Lighter perpetuals directly from X via tweets, or through the Solvana web app in a secure environment. Solvana’s intelligence layer understands user intent, analyzes the market, and helps execute perpetual trades on Lighter through simple natural-language commands.
